Class AdjustmentTriggerHelper

public inherited sharing class AdjustmentTriggerHelper

Helper class for AdjustmentTriggerHandler. Contains the business logic for Adjustment__c trigger operations, including truncating the description into a short description field for grid display.

public static void setShortDescription(AdjustmentTriggerHandler handler)

Sets the ShortDescription__c field by stripping newlines from Description__c and truncating to the length configured in ADJUSTMENT_SHORTDESCRIPTION_LENGTH. Only processes records where Description__c is new or changed.
